easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Brass's Bounty and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}
Repeat from step 2.
